episodes.title: Senior Year
episodes.summary: Ordinary high school student Bong Seok hides a secret.

episodes.title: Booyang: Family Support, Levitation
episodes.summary: Mi Hyun hides Bong Seok's superpowers, but the mysterious incidents on social media make her anxious.
The closer Bong Seok grows to Hee Soo, the more risk of exposure he draws.

episodes.title: The Secret
episodes.summary: Bong Seok's secret is exposed and Hee Soo walks him home. Frank searches for his third target.

episodes.title: Recall
episodes.summary: Hee Soo assures Bong Seok that his secret is safe by revealing her own secret.

episodes.title: Bungaeman
episodes.summary: Jeon Gyu Do's past is revealed. The NIS finds out information about Frank.

episodes.title: The Stranger
episodes.summary: Frank recalls his past as he eliminates his targets. After Frank's visit, Mi Hyun suppresses her son.

episodes.title: Black
episodes.summary: In 1994, Mi Hyun approaches black ops agent Kim Doo Sik at Min Yong Joon's orders.

episodes.title: Humanists
episodes.summary: Doo Sik and Mi Hyun grow closer, and Doo Sik suggests that they deceive Min Yong Joon.

episodes.title: The Monster
episodes.summary: Joo Won, who leads his gang with his monstrous abilities, is betrayed and becomes a fugitive.

episodes.title: Romanticist
episodes.summary: Ji Hee gradually opens up to Joo Won.

episodes.title: Partners
episodes.summary: Doo-sik shows up at Mi-hyun's apartment with a plan to escape Deputy Director Min for good.

episodes.title: Jang Juwon
episodes.summary: After the Black Team disbands, Ju-won is offered a mission by Deputy Director Min to revive the team.

episodes.title: The Idiot
episodes.summary: Jae Man tries to save his wife with his strength and Ju Won is sent in to subdue him.

episodes.title: N.T.D.P.
episodes.summary: Mi Hyun and Ju Won watch the auditorium video and head to Jeong Won High, while Gyedo discovers Ju Hwa.

episodes.title: The Man Between
episodes.summary: With Mi Hyun's question, Il Hwan reminisces about his past.

episodes.title: Awakening
episodes.summary: Jun Hwa attacks Hui Soo, and Bong Seok awakens his powers to save her.

episodes.title: South and North
episodes.summary: Mi Hyun asks Deok Yoon where Doo Sik is, and he tells her what happened in the North.

episodes.title: Final Battle
episodes.summary: The fight takes a new turn with the appearance of a new North Korean superbeing, Jae Seok.

episodes.title: Graduation Day
episodes.summary: Parents and children fight to protect each other. Will this repeated war ever end?
